description:
endpoint.inventory.shipping_board is in the Storefront seat's tools/list, but every call to it is refused with 403.

What I did:
1. tools/list -> includes endpoint.inventory.shipping_board ("Dispatch planning board ... Read-only.").
2. tools.search {"query": "inventory level"} -> returns it with in_tools_list: true, risk: read.
3. tools/call endpoint.inventory.shipping_board {}.

Expected: the brief (section 6) says a tool you may not use is absent from the list, not refused when called. So either the tool is absent for this seat, or it is callable.

Actual: the call returns isError: "This view reads DeliveryChallan, and your role is not granted read on it. The endpoint's own gate authorises one entity; it does not authorise the others the view consumes. {\"code\": \"request_refused\", \"status\": 403}".

Impact: catalogue scoping and endpoint gating disagree, so an agent that plans from tools/list or tools.search picks a tool it can never use.

Seat: Storefront (team08; roles sales_user, user, agent_user; allowed_apps storefront, agent, crm). Business: Suryodaya Precision Works. Reproducible: yes, every attempt on 2026-10-10.

Coupon.create accepts a validity window that ends before it starts (valid_to earlier than valid_from).

What I did:
1. Coupon.create {"code": "T08-REPRO-INVERTED", "type": "percentage", "value": 1, "valid_from": "2027-06-30", "valid_to": "2027-01-01", "is_active": false}.
2. Coupon.get id b61a89cf-7b4a-457c-a28d-786ac8787e73.

Expected: rejected with an invalid_arguments error on valid_to, because a window that ends before it starts can never be open.

Actual: accepted and stored as given (valid_from 2027-06-30, valid_to 2027-01-01). The platform does validate valid_to against the creation date (valid_to 2026-01-01 is rejected with "Valid To cannot be before 2026-10-10, the date this record was created"), but not against valid_from.

Corroboration: 48 of the 105 coupons already in the book have valid_to before valid_from (e.g. VC8379/1862: 2025-12-27 to 2025-12-14), and 38 of those 48 are is_active = 1.

The repro coupon T08-REPRO-INVERTED was created inactive and is safe to delete.

Seat: Storefront (team08; roles sales_user, user, agent_user; allowed_apps storefront, agent, crm). Business: Suryodaya Precision Works. Reproducible: yes, every attempt on 2026-10-10.

AgentMemory.list with `search` never matches a memory's content, so an agent cannot recall its own memories by topic.

What I did:
1. AgentMemory.create {"category": "fact", "source": "system", "content": "T08 smoke test 2026-10-10T20:28:08: storefront agent can write to its own AgentMemory."} -> id 6be85377-de01-457a-a443-da9cf6ba4639.
2. AgentMemory.get on that id -> returns the content above.
3. AgentMemory.list {"search": "smoke"}, {"search": "T08 smoke test"}, {"search": "storefront agent"}, and REST GET /api/AgentMemory?search=smoke.
4. AgentMemory.list {"limit": 50} with no search.

Expected: steps 3 find the row, since content is the only free-text field an agent writes and search is how it recalls by topic.

Actual: all four searches return total: 0, while the unfiltered list in step 4 returns the row.

Impact: memory recall has to page through every row.

Seat: Storefront (team08; roles sales_user, user, agent_user; allowed_apps storefront, agent, crm). Business: Suryodaya Precision Works. Reproducible: yes, every attempt on 2026-10-10.

WebOrder.create accepts a caller-supplied payment_gateway_payment_id, so an unpaid order carries a payment reference that no gateway issued, and it can no longer be corrected.

What I did:
1. WebOrder.create {"customer_name": "[T08 fixture] paid-not-released", "customer_email": "t08-fixture@example.com", "payment_method": "razorpay", "payment_provider": "simulated", "payment_gateway_payment_id": "SIM-T08-FIXTURE", "items": [1 line]} -> WEB-2026-00110 (id 5f14edff-201a-4a4a-90a2-ede37f787258).
2. WebOrder.get on that id.
3. WebOrder.update {"id": ..., "payment_gateway_payment_id": ""}.

Expected: payment reference fields are set only by the payment flow (endpoint.storefront.payment.verify / WebOrder.confirm_payment) and are rejected or ignored on create, the same way a redemption counter should be derived rather than written.

Actual: step 2 shows status pending_payment, payment_gateway_payment_id SIM-T08-FIXTURE, funding_amount null. Step 3 is refused: "Cannot modify WebOrder in 'pending_payment' status. Only notes/tags/assignments can be changed." So a fabricated reference is accepted at creation and then locked.

Impact: anything that treats a gateway payment id as evidence of payment (reconciliation, an agent checking payment against fulfilment) sees an order as paid when no payment was taken.

WEB-2026-00110 is Team 08's harness fixture and is kept on purpose as the repro.

Seat: Storefront (team08; roles sales_user, user, agent_user; allowed_apps storefront, agent, crm). Business: Suryodaya Precision Works. Reproducible: yes, every attempt on 2026-10-10.

GET /api/accounting/locale returns 403 for non-accounting seats, although the capstone brief tells every agent to read it to learn its tax regime.

What I did: as team08 (Storefront seat), GET /api/accounting/locale with a valid bearer token. Also checked tools/list for a locale tool.

Expected: the Session 20 brief (section 6) says "GET /api/accounting/locale tells your agent which regime it is in" and grades every agent on working in both jurisdictions. So any authenticated seat should be able to read the locale (read-only), or the brief should name the per-app equivalent.

Actual: 403 {"detail": "App 'accounting' is not enabled for your account"}. tools/list has no accounting locale tool for this seat. The only locale available to Storefront is endpoint.storefront.locale, which does return country, currency and tax regime. Seats with no app-specific locale endpoint have no documented way to learn their regime.

Seat: Storefront (team08; roles sales_user, user, agent_user; allowed_apps storefront, agent, crm). Business: Suryodaya Precision Works. Reproducible: yes, every attempt on 2026-10-10.
